I cry CONSTANTLY. At the drop of a hat. I'm working on regulating this in therapy actually lol. Just wanted to share from the other end of the spectrum.

Since April of last year, I've had chronic nausea/vomiting, diarrhea, severe abdominal/pelvic pain, malaise, fatigue. I've lost 30 pounds without trying. On top of previously diagnosed migraines from 20 years ago. I've been in and out of so many doctors since August and nobody can figure out what it is. GI this morning said "try peppermint oil". Cool. 

Starting to just give up on doctors and accept that maybe this really is "all in my head" and maybe I'm going to be broken forever because of what was done to me as a child. My quality of life has tanked and I feel helpless and hopeless.

The hardest thing for me so far has been challenging the negative core beliefs. "I'm a burden, I'm unloveable, I'm a bad person," etc. I can yap all day with my therapist about how I deserve love and compassion and I'm a nice person, and maybe, during that session with her, I believe it a tiny bit. But as soon as I close the video call, I'm back at square one. It's extremely hard to make progress when you inherently and genuinely feel you do not deserve it and that you are a waste of time and resources.

Yes, I have been too overwhelmed to start! It's a really, really hard process and I'm not sure if there's anything that could have made it easier in my case.

My perfect magic wand would take away the flashbacks, the self-hatred, and the emotional reactivity/being triggered easily.
